text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, during the lead-up to the
Queen
Elizabeth II Cup, I find Sweep
Tosho standing on
the track... not
moving a muscle.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: No!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems she's being as difficult as ever.
But when I
follow her gaze...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... Thank you so much for running with me.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Don't sweat it, Kawakami. By the
way, you
really came out of nowhere on
that last stretch.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Well, we're racing Sweep, after all!
We're gonna
get blown out of the water
if we don't give it our
all!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And when we do...
...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: ...? What's wrong, Kawakami?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: It's just...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'm truly, truly sorry for bumping into you that day!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text:
Oh! ...But seriously, how many times do I
have to
tell you there's nothing to
apologize for?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text:
Just make sure you don't hold anything
back
when we race for real. Remember,
I'm not settling
for second place.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text:
Sweep's not beating me, and neither are
you.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but when you're running, be careful
not to do
anything you think is risky!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text:
You're too nice, so if anything
happened, I just
know you wouldn't be
able to forgive yourself.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text:
Now that we're rivals for real, I want us
to
compete for real—and to keep on
competing too.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You have my word as a princess that I
will do my
very best! Both in the Queen
Elizabeth II Cup and
beyond!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Of course they do!
choice_data_list: あの2人、いい表情をしているな
あの2人、いい表情をしているね

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
They just had racing magic cast on them
by a
super special witch! If they didn't
look happy,
we'd have a problem!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
This is Magical Girl Sweepy you're
talking to here!
There's no spell I can't
cast!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Listen here, Familiar. The next time I use
my
racing magic, I'm gonna fill the whole
world with
witches and wizards!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna make it so everyone can use magic. And then they'll all be my apprentices!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. ♪ And then I'm gonna make
everyone work
real hard.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I can't have the world getting
lame again
when I'm not around
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
This world's got magic in it! We've gotta
keep it
fun no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's finally time for this year's Queen
Elizabeth II
Cup!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Will this be a triumphant return for the
queen who
dominated the Takarazuka
Kinen?! I can't wait to
find out whether
anyone has what it takes to take
her
down!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: This is the Queen Elizabeth II Cup? When I saw it on TV when I was younger, it seemed more...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whoa, now. Don't tell me you're gettin' scared, Scarlet!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm only here cause you invited me,
remember?
You said we should come see
the ultimate race
since it's almost time
for us to debut.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me?! Who are you calling
"scared"?! I'm
getting tired of your
idiocy!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: 'Scuse me?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
When I saw the Queen Elizabeth II Cup
on TV, it
looked more beautiful—more
elegant and
graceful.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It was so beautiful, I felt like I was
mesmerized.
But this atmosphere today...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's so rugged and awesome, huh? I feel
like
something's really about to kick off.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But you keep mumbling to yourself. Just
come out
with it already, Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You like heated races like this too,
don'tcha?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Welcome back to the turf.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: All right. You guys know the deal, right?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm here to beat you. I'm going to
come at
you with everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You do realize I'm the one who's gonna
win this?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome to try. But I'm going to
cross that
finish line long before any of
you.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hmph. All right, let's do this.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. You're in for a good time, so just
wait
right there.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
But when I start running, make sure you
enjoy
every second!
